question: Who among the following won awards and recognitions for the development of Kathak dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Shovana Narayan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Shovana Narayan won various awards and recognitions for her contribution to the development of the Kathak dance form.**

 
 
• She was awarded the **Padma Shri in 1984 and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1999 f**or her outstanding contribution to Kathak dance.
 
• Shovana Narayan was also recognized with the National Award for Creative and Experimental Dance in 1992 and the Delhi State Sahitya Kala Parishad Award in 1980.
 
• She was also honored with the Rajiv Gandhi Excellence Award and the Woman of the Year Award by the American Biographical Institute in 2006.
 
 
 
• **Uday Shankar pioneered modern Indian dance** and was known for blending Indian classical dance with Western ballet.
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra was a renowned Odissi dancer **and guru. Amala Akkineni is an Indian film actress and animal welfare activist.
 
• **Hence, the correct answer is option 3, Shovana Narayan.**
